_comment: Folder under /sd/data/ROMs -> EmulatorJS system + display metadata. 'id' MUST match the folder name on the SD (and the list firmware provisioning creates in nucleo_storage.c); 'core' is the EmulatorJS system OR core id (EJS_core accepts either — getCore resolves a core name back to its system). 'exts' filters the listing (lowercase, no dot). 'bios' names a file in the same folder that the core needs loaded alongside the game.
_cores: nes=fceumm · snes=snes9x · gb/gbc=gambatte · gba=mgba · segaMD/segaGG=genesis_plus_gx · segaMS=smsplus · pce=mednafen_pce · ngp=mednafen_ngp · lynx=handy · arcade=fbneo · cps1/cps2=fbalpha2012_*
_zip: Every system accepts 'zip': arcade sets are always zipped, and EmulatorJS extracts them in the browser (emulatorjs/compression/extractzip.js), which keeps the SD smaller.
_arcade: Neo Geo and CPS romsets must match the core's expected set — the fbalpha2012_* cores want FB Alpha 0.2.97.x, and fbneo wants a modern FBNeo set. A mismatched set fails to boot the game, it does not degrade.
_coreFile: Actual libretro core shipped at emulatorjs/cores/<coreFile>-wasm.data. The player probes it: present -> run fully offline from the SD; absent -> fall back to the EmulatorJS CDN.
_romsets: Arcade cores are romset-version locked: the core refuses to boot a set it does not recognise, it does not degrade. Verified on hardware: fbneo rejected an FBA 0.2.97.38 Neo Geo set ('Romset is unknown'), and fbalpha2012_cps1 (v0.2.97.28) dropped to the RetroArch menu on the same-era CPS set. 'warn' is surfaced in the game list so the user is told BEFORE launching instead of meeting a cryptic core error.
